verdict.rationale: Daytona documents an official MCP server that lets AI agents work with Daytona Sandboxes programmatically. It is initialized with supported agents including Claude, Cursor and Windsurf, and a probe confirms the dedicated MCP docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and documented detail on the specific tools/operations and authentication the server exposes.
